name: aul-kitchen-kiosk-build
description: Isolated Kiosk browser build pipeline (STEP 81). Bundles kiosk/browser/createBrowserKiosk.js and its existing CommonJS Kiosk dependency graph into one browser-loadable ESM artifact via esbuild. Not wired into production. Not deployed. The Kiosk domain source under kiosk/**/*.js remains CommonJS and untouched - this package only adds a build step on top of it. Firebase SDK is never imported by that source (it is received via dependency injection), so it is never bundled here either.
